# Chucao

> Kit de marca + sistema de diseño web de devsChile

## Getting Started

- [README](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/README.md): Documentación principal del proyecto
- [Design System](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/DESIGN.md): Sistema de diseño y marca
- [Changelog](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/CHANGELOG.md): Historial de cambios

## Components

- [ch-accordion](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-accordion/): ch-accordion component
- [ch-alert](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-alert/): Block-level status message.
- [ch-badge](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-badge/): ch-badge component
- [ch-button](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-button/): ch-button component
- [ch-card](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-card/): ch-card component
- [ch-checkbox](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-checkbox/): ch-checkbox component
- [ch-divider](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-divider/): ch-divider component
- [ch-input](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-input/): ch-input component
- [ch-link](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-link/): ch-link component
- [ch-modal](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-modal/): Modal dialog, built on the native `<dialog>` element and opened with
- [ch-radio](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-radio/): ch-radio component
- [ch-select](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-select/): ch-select component
- [ch-spinner](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-spinner/): Loading indicator.
- [ch-switch](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-switch/): ch-switch component
- [ch-tabs](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-tabs/): ch-tabs component
- [ch-textarea](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-textarea/): ch-textarea component
- [ch-tooltip](https://devschile.github.io/chucao/components/ch-tooltip/): Short help text shown on hover and on focus.
